title: Skill
description: Schema for a compendium Skill entry (Rpg/Compendium/Skills/Skill.cs + SkillExpressions.cs). The compendium file should be a JSON object whose keys are skill IDs.

Expr.description: An expression: either a DSL string (leading '=', e.g. "= 1 + target.constitution"; see Rpg/Scripting/DOCS.md) or a literal (number, string, boolean, null, or an array of those).

ArgumentSlot.description: A single argument slot: either one type string or an array of accepted types (the player can provide any of them).

DamageBlock.description: Describes the damage dealt by an attack skill.

condition.description: Condition (boolean) expression. If false, the attack misses.

description.description: String expression. Human-readable reason shown when the attack misses.

Skill.description: A skill compendium entry. 'type' determines which subclass is instantiated.

type.description: 'arbitrary' for a general-purpose skill; 'attack' for an ArbitraryAttackSkill.

execute.description: Effect expression. Evaluated on each execution tick.

start.description: Effect expression. Evaluated when the skill starts.

cancel.description: Effect expression. Evaluated when the skill is cancelled. Variables: [$0 = interrupted (bool)].

canCancel.description: Condition (boolean) expression. Whether the skill can be cancelled by the user.

canExecute.description: Condition (boolean) expression. Whether the skill can be used at all (CanBeUsed check, evaluated on caller entity only).

condition.description: Condition (boolean) expression. Arbitrary condition available for use in other expressions.

canTarget.description: Condition (boolean) expression. Whether a given target is a valid target for this skill.

delay.description: Number expression. Tick delay before the skill executes after being used.

cooldown.description: Number expression. Tick cooldown after the skill finishes.

duration.description: Number expression. How many ticks the skill's execution lasts. Defaults to 1.

layers.description: Skill layer identifiers that control visibility and grouping. Defaults to ['default'].

arguments.description: Ordered list of argument slots. Each slot is a type string or an array of accepted types.

damage.description: Damage definition. Only meaningful for 'attack' type skills.

doesHit.description: Hit condition and miss reason. Only meaningful for 'attack' type skills.

onHit.description: Effect expression. Evaluated when the attack hits. Only meaningful for 'attack' type skills.

onAttack.description: Effect expression. Evaluated when the attack resolves (hit or miss). Only meaningful for 'attack' type skills.
